summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K announcing it will maintain the 12.00% annual regular dividend rate on its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock (STRC) for semi-monthly periods beginning on or after October 16, 2026, disclosed via its website. The board declared semi-monthly cash dividends of $0.50 per STRC share payable October 31, 2026 to holders of record October 15, 2026, and $0.50 payable November 15, 2026 to holders of record October 31, 2026, the latter contingent on Daily Dividend Amendments passing and a related filing. What to watch: whether the contingent November payment is triggered and how STRC trades versus its $100 target.
